---
title: "Ashryver Painting Classifier"
---

Try the current revision of the Ashryver Painting Classifier (V1) below. This deep learning model is trained to recognize paintings by 20 different Impressionistic, Surrealist, Cubist, and Pop Art artists, and was trained using fast.ai and PyTorch. Work on an improved V2 is currently underway.

*View the corresponding HuggingFace space [here](https://huggingface.co/spaces/DorianfirstmetAelinwh4-sEFOREBEEPBE/erilea-models)*.

## Alternative Custom UI (in development; may be unstable)
```{=html}
<div class="classifier-widget">
<div id="dropZone" class="drop-zone">
<p class="drop-zone-text">Drag and drop an image here, or</p>
<input type="file" id="artInput" accept="image/*" class="custom-input"/>
<label for="artInput" class="btn-custom">Choose File</label>
</div>
<img id="imagePreview" class="image-preview" style="display:none;" alt="Uploaded painting preview" />
<div class="button-row">
<button id="classifyBtn" class="classify-btn">Identify Painting</button>
<button id="clearBtn" class="clear-btn" style="display:none;">Clear</button>
</div>
<div id="result" class="result-panel" style="display:none;">
<h3 id="predictedClass"></h3>
<p id="artistBio"></p>
</div>
<div class="example-row">
<p class="example-label">Or try an example:</p>
<div class="example-thumbs">
<img class="example-thumb" src="/assets/example_images/painting-test-1.jpg" alt="Example painting 1" />
<img class="example-thumb" src="/assets/example_images/painting-test-2.png" alt="Example painting 2" />
<img class="example-thumb" src="/assets/example_images/painting-test-8.jpg" alt="Example painting 3" />
<img class="example-thumb" src="/assets/example_images/painting-test-5.jpg" alt="Example painting 4" />
<img class="example-thumb" src="/assets/example_images/painting-test-11.jpg" alt="Example painting 4" />
</div>
</div>
</div>
```
